description: Defines a template class for a lock-free bounded multi-producer multi-consumer queue using MoodyCamel's concurrent queue library, including specializations for non-blocking and sleeping wait policies, with methods for enqueueing, dequeueing, and creating consumers.

classes.name: concurrent_queue
classes.description: Template class implementing a lock-free bounded MPMC queue with specializations for different wait policies.

classes.name: concurrent_queue<T, concurrent_queue_policy::moodycamel_lockfree_bounded_mpmc, concurrent_queue_wait_policy::non_blocking>
classes.description: Main class template for a non-blocking lock-free bounded MPMC queue.

classes.name: concurrent_queue<T, concurrent_queue_policy::moodycamel_lockfree_bounded_mpmc, concurrent_queue_wait_policy::sleep>
classes.description: Specialization of the queue class for sleeping wait policy, with blocking dequeue operations.

classes.name: consumer_type
classes.description: Inner class providing consumer operations for the queue, including try_pop and try_pop_bulk.

methods.name: calculate_capacity
methods.description: Calculates the actual capacity reserved by the MoodyCamel queue based on requested size and number of producers.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to enqueue an element into the queue without blocking.

methods.name: try_push_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to enqueue a bulk of elements into the queue.

methods.name: push_blocking
methods.description: Enqueues an element into the queue, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to dequeue an element without blocking.

methods.name: try_pop_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to dequeue a bulk of elements.

methods.name: create_consumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer object for the queue.
